title: SimBench-BW platform validation matrix
description: Declares, per roster row, which platforms the row must pass on. Portable (tier=P) rows must be "both". Rows declared sm_120a-only compile-gate to rtx_5090_blackwell; rows declared sm_90a-only compile-gate to h100.

platforms.description: "both" = MUST pass on both; "either" = MUST pass on at least one; "h100" / "rtx_5090_blackwell" = single-platform MUST-pass.

reason.description: Optional short rationale, especially for single-platform rows (e.g. "wgmma requires sm_90a", "sparse mxf4 requires sm_120a").
